text:
**My pick: ALLPOWERS P1800 + SP037 400 W kit, about $731.** It's the best value for most people. The price and specs below come from a comparison on Dealectric, which sells these through affiliate links, so it has a financial interest in the brands it recommends. I've marked which links are affiliate links.

- **Battery:** 1,024 Wh LiFePO4, the longer-lasting chemistry
- **Output:** 1,800 W
- **Panel:** a 400 W panel, about twice what most 1 kWh kits include
- **Price:** $731, or $657.90 with code ALLPOWERS26 (the site says it tested the code in the cart on 10/24)
- **Buy:** [ALLPOWERS P1800 + SP037 kit](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-p1800-sp037-solar-kit) (affiliate link)

**Other good options by need**

| Need | Pick | Price | Link |
|---|---|---|---|
| Name-brand 1 kWh | Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2 (1,070 Wh, 200 W panel), the editor's choice in [Talk of the House's roundup](https://www.talkofthehouse.com/best-solar-generator-kits-with-panels/) | $699 | See roundup |
| Name-brand 1 kWh | EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic + 220 W | $699 | Listed in the Dealectric comparison, no direct link |
| Home backup (about 2 kWh) | BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W (2,073.6 Wh, accepts up to 1,000 W of panels later; ships from Oct 29) | $1,199 | [Buy](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit) (affiliate) |
| Tight budget | ALLPOWERS VOLIX P300 + 100 W (256 Wh) | $208.99 | [Buy](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-volix-p300-100w-solar-kit) (affiliate) |
| Higher-capacity small unit | BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 100 W (288 Wh) | $459.99 | [Buy](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-30-v2-100w-solar-kit) (affiliate) |

**Things to know**
- **Real-world charging:** A folding panel delivers roughly 60–75% of its rating in good sun. A 200 W panel adds about 600–750 Wh on a clear day, so a 1 kWh station with a 200 W panel takes more than a day of sun to refill.
- **Prices vary by store:** Amazon lists the BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W at $899, versus $769 on Dealectric. Compare before buying. You can check [Amazon's listings](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included) or [Costco's](https://www.costco.com/home-solar-power.html), which carries Jackery kits like the Explorer 1500 v2 at $899.99 (out of stock at the Mountain View warehouse).
- **Skip the ALLPOWERS R4000 kit:** At $2,198, it costs about $400 more than buying the station and panel separately.

If you tell me what you'll power (camping, a fridge, a CPAP, whole-home backup) and your budget, I can narrow this down to one.
